title: Season 1
overview: Loki explores the Time Variance Authority and investigates a dangerous variant across the multiverse.

episodes.title: Glorious Purpose
episodes.overview: After stealing the Tesseract, Loki is brought before the Time Variance Authority.

episodes.title: The Variant
episodes.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work, but not everyone at the TVA is thrilled with the God of Mischief's presence.

episodes.title: Journey Into Mystery
episodes.overview: Loki tries to escape The Void, a desolate purgatory where he meets variant versions of himself.

episodes.title: For All Time. Always.
episodes.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale as Loki and Sylvie embark on a perilous date with destiny.
